<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="390" height="844" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="brandGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FE3675"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="3" stdDeviation="5" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.12"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="22" y="19" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
    <line x1="320" y1="16" x2="320" y2="19" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="325" y1="13" x2="325" y2="19" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="330" y1="10" x2="330" y2="19" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="335" y1="7" x2="335" y2="19" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="351" cy="14" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="354" y1="17" x2="357" y2="20" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="365" y="8" width="20" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="367" y="10" width="14" height="8" rx="1.5" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="386" y="12" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header and progress -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="29,59 21,67 29,75" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2.3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="47" y="72" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Profile setup</text>
    <text x="342" y="72" text-anchor="end" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#939393">2 of 5</text>
    <rect x="21" y="91" width="348" height="5" rx="3" fill="#EAEDF1"/>
    <rect x="21" y="91" width="139" height="5" rx="3" fill="url(#brandGradient)"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Main content -->
  <g>
    <text x="21" y="146" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="30" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">What's your gender?</text>
    <text x="21" y="174" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Choose the option that best describes you.</text>

    <!-- Woman card shadow and card -->
    <rect x="21" y="204" width="348" height="64" rx="14" fill="#000000" opacity="0.07"/>
    <rect x="21" y="201" width="348" height="64" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="53" cy="233" r="17" fill="#FE3675" opacity="0.12"/>
    <circle cx="53" cy="228" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#EA5D6B" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <ellipse cx="53" cy="241" rx="8" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#EA5D6B" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="84" y="239" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Woman</text>
    <circle cx="344" cy="233" r="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1.5"/>

    <!-- Man card -->
    <rect x="21" y="281" width="348" height="64" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="53" cy="313" r="17" fill="#4396F7" opacity="0.12"/>
    <circle cx="53" cy="308" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#4396F7" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <ellipse cx="53" cy="321" rx="8" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#4396F7" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="84" y="319" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Man</text>
    <circle cx="344" cy="313" r="10" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1.5"/>

    <!-- More options card selected -->
    <rect x="21" y="358" width="348" height="64" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="53" cy="390" r="17" fill="url(#brandGradient)" opacity="0.14"/>
    <circle cx="47" cy="390" r="2.5" fill="#FE3675"/>
    <circle cx="53" cy="390" r="2.5" fill="#FE3675"/>
    <circle cx="59" cy="390" r="2.5" fill="#FE3675"/>
    <text x="84" y="396" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">More options</text>
    <circle cx="344" cy="390" r="10" fill="#FE3675"/>
    <polyline points="339,390 343,394 350,386" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

    <text x="21" y="458" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Display on my profile</text>
    <text x="21" y="481" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">You can change this anytime in your settings.</text>

    <rect x="21" y="501" width="20" height="20" rx="4" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <polyline points="25,511 30,516 38,506" fill="none" stroke="url(#brandGradient)" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="52" y="516" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#4A4A4A">Show my gender on my profile</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Continue button disabled -->
  <g>
    <rect x="56" y="555" width="278" height="44" rx="22" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <text x="195" y="583" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#939393">CONTINUE</text>
  </g>

  <text x="195" y="627" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Your gender helps us personalize your experience.</text>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <line x1="0" y1="686" x2="390" y2="686" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
    <polygon points="39,715 49,706 59,715 59,727 39,727" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <polygon points="39,715 49,706 59,715" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="49" y="746" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#939393">Home</text>

    <circle cx="128" cy="715" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <polyline points="128,709 130,713 134,714 131,717 132,721 128,719 124,721 125,717 122,714 126,713" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <text x="128" y="746" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#939393">Discover</text>

    <rect x="195" y="707" width="21" height="16" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <polygon points="200,723 204,723 201,728" fill="#FE3675"/>
    <circle cx="201" cy="715" r="1.3" fill="#FE3675"/>
    <circle cx="206" cy="715" r="1.3" fill="#FE3675"/>
    <circle cx="211" cy="715" r="1.3" fill="#FE3675"/>
    <text x="205" y="746" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#FE3675">Messages</text>

    <circle cx="285" cy="711" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <ellipse cx="285" cy="725" rx="11" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="285" y="746" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#939393">Profile</text>

    <circle cx="351" cy="704" r="4" fill="#FE3675"/>
    <line x1="347" y1="704" x2="355" y2="704" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="351" y1="700" x2="351" y2="708" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Home indicator -->
  <rect x="145" y="816" width="100" height="5" rx="3" fill="#000000"/>
</svg>
